Title: A Roof Over My Head
Text:
I've arrived at the State Hotel, where newcomers are provided with accommodation while they settle into life in Gramados.

I should speak with Elena Marvik, the receptionist, to learn how the State Hotel works and get a room of my own.
CompleteText:
Elena Marvik has assigned me a room at the State Hotel and provided me with a package containing some basic furniture.

My room number is written on the package. I should find my room before opening it and start making myself at home.
